claims.name: Ijen Health-Screening Coordination
claims.canonical_text: On routes that include Mount Ijen, JVTO integrates health screening as a practical safety step, not a formality.

evidence.description: Historical press evidence — 'Pengunjung Kawah Ijen Wajib Bawa Surat Keterangan Sehat' (TIMES Indonesia, 2024-01-05). The instrument it reports is BBKSDA circular SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024; corroborated independently by E030 (detikJatim) and E031 (Liputan6).

Press evidence naming the instrument — 'Mau Wisata ke Ijen Banyuwangi? Simak 6 Syarat Ini' (detikJatim, 2024-01-05). Publishes the six TWA Kawah Ijen visitor requirements verbatim and attributes them to BBKSDA circular SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024. Quotes Dwi Putro Sugiarto, Kepala Seksi Konservasi BKSDA Wilayah V Banyuwangi.

Press evidence — 'Kawah Ijen Kembali Dibuka untuk Wisatawan Usai Ditutup Tiga Hari' (Liputan6, 2024-01-06). Independently cites the same circular, SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024, on the reopening after a three-day closure. Quotes Sigit Hariwibowo, Kepala Pos TWA Kawah Ijen.

BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024 — supporting authority for the Ijen health screening, not its source. The circular reopened TWA Kawah Ijen on 2024-09-08 and requires visitors to follow the applicable SOP (basic climbing safety equipment — torch, mask, cold-weather clothing), to follow "protokol kesehatan yang berlaku", and to book entry tickets online via tiket.bbksdajatim.org. It does not itself state the health-certificate requirement — the protocol it defers to is the one SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024 introduced on 2024-01-06. Cite E020/E030/E031 for the requirement itself, and this entry for the circular that keeps it in force.

Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu SIP (Surat Izin Praktik) Dokter Umum No. 503.446/664/DRU/4/430.9.13/2026, issued by DPMPTSP Kabupaten Bondowoso 2026-01-06 (Permenkes 2052/2011); STR QN00001073380217 valid to 2031-01-06. BSrE-certified electronic document (UU ITE 2008 Pasal 5 ayat 1). Physical document on file: raw/evidence/credentials/sip-dr-ahmad-irwandanu-2026.pdf (sha256 82f2535b87066fef23cf3012ed3bc1cb18c124e03045ab544067e51d78ac80aa). STR/KKI publicly verifiable.
7 Ijen incidents (2015-2026), 4 fatalities — 50% fitness-related (heart attack, exhaustion). Directly validates health screening mandate.

Sample JVTO health-screening certificate (surat keterangan sehat / FORMULIR SKRINING KESEHATAN) — a bilingual ID/EN Health Screening Form recording guest vitals (blood pressure, SpO2) and the fitness result. Bears a BSSN/BSrE (Balai Sertifikasi Elektronik) certified electronic signature — banner 'DOKUMEN INI DITANDATANGANI SECARA ELEKTRONIK ... diterbitkan oleh Balai Sertifikasi Elektronik' — issued under SIP-licensed medical supervision (see E007). Directly evidences the per-certificate electronic-signature format (upgrades the prior 'corroborated' status). Representative sample received 2026-08-01; the guest PII in the stored document is not reproduced in any published/derived text. Physical document on file: raw/evidence/credentials/surat-sehat-sample.pdf (sha256 d10b9f8a0837cc30992d9d5d0cf8f4cb40c909d5df56869615d4967d4ad04c27).

narrative.ai_snippet: JVTO includes the mandatory Ijen health screening on itineraries that include Mount Ijen — a health certificate is required for every guest before crater entry (BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024), documented in the Travel Guide. The screening is conducted by SIP-licensed Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu — a registered Indonesian physician whose STR (QN00001073380217) is publicly verifiable via Kemenkes SatuSehat / KKI — included in the tour and done at each guest's hotel before the hike briefing. The issued surat sehat is electronically signed (BSrE / Balai Sertifikasi Elektronik) and traceable to that named, licensed doctor — tamper-evident and accountable, a verifiable alternative to a self-issued form, which matters because counterfeit surat sehat have been documented in circulation at Ijen.
narrative.short: A health certificate is mandatory for every Ijen guest — screening by SIP-licensed Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu (STR publicly verifiable via Kemenkes / KKI), included and done at your hotel before the briefing. The surat sehat is BSrE electronically-signed and traceable to that named doctor — a real, tamper-evident, accountable certificate rather than a self-issued form.
narrative.cs_reply: If your itinerary includes Ijen, we'll guide you through the mandatory health screening — a certificate is required for every guest before crater entry (BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024). It's included in your tour and we do it at your hotel before the guide briefing, with SIP-licensed Dr. Ahmad Irwandanu (a registered physician whose STR is publicly checkable on Kemenkes SatuSehat / KKI). The surat sehat is electronically signed (BSrE) and traceable to that named doctor, so it's a real, tamper-evident, accountable certificate rather than a self-issued form. A safety step before the hike, not a formality.

final_value.governs: Reopening of TWA Kawah Ijen from 2024-09-08, and the access conditions that follow from it (SOP, basic climbing safety equipment, compliance with the applicable health protocol, online ticketing).
final_value.health_certificate_requirement_source: BBKSDA SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024, in force since 2024-01-06 — see E020, E030, E031.

evidence.description: NIB, TDUP, HPWKI all publicly verifiable with SHA-256 anchors

Menkumham decree AHU-0010187.AH.01.01.TAHUN 2023 approving PT Java Volcano Rendezvous as a legal entity, register entry AHU-0026835. Published at public/legal/AHU-PTJVR.pdf with a SHA-256 anchor, so the served bytes can be checked against the published hash by anyone.

Practice licence (SIP 503.446/664/DRU/4/430.9.13/2026) of the physician who signs the Ijen health certificates — issued by DPMPTSP Bondowoso, BSrE-signed, STR valid to 2031-01-06 — published at public/screening/SIP_DOKTER_AHMAD_IRWANDANU_2026.pdf with a SHA-256 anchor. E007 records the same licence as a document held on file; this entry records that it is publicly downloadable and hash-verifiable.

BBKSDA Jawa Timur circular SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024, "Pembukaan Kawasan Taman Wisata Alam (TWA) Kawah Ijen", issued at Sidoarjo 2024-09-06 and signed by the Kepala Balai Besar. It reopens TWA Kawah Ijen from 2024-09-08 for nature tourism, hiking and research, lifting the closure imposed on 2024-07-12 by SE.1289/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/07/2024. Its conditions are: follow the applicable SOP, prepare basic climbing safety equipment (torch, mask, cold-weather clothing), follow "protokol kesehatan yang berlaku", and book entry tickets online via tiket.bbksdajatim.org. Published with a SHA-256 anchor.
